bug_description.original: Detailed Report: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5787862593830912 Project: elfutils Fuzzing Engine: afl Fuzz Target: fuzz-libdwfl Job Type: afl_asan_elfutils Crash Type: UNKNOWN Crash Address: 0x7fdae5ef5000 Crash State: read_long_names __libelf_next_arhdr_wrlock dup_elf Sanitizer: address (ASAN) Recommended Security Severity: Medium
bug_description.normalized: elfutils libelf read_long_names() passes the archive member header 'ar_size' field (a fixed 10-byte, space-padded, non-NUL-terminated decimal string mmap'd from the input .ar archive) directly to atol() without first checking that it starts with a digit. When the field contains no digit (e.g. all spaces) and sits at the end of the mapped archive, atol() skips leading whitespace and scans byte-by-byte past the end of the mmap'd region, causing an out-of-bounds / wild-pointer READ (ASan 'unknown-crash', READ of size 985). Reported under CWE-190/191/680; the observed memory-safety fault is an out-of-bounds read (CWE-125). Fixed by adding an `if (!isdigit(string[0])) return NULL;` guard before atol.

source.description: Project-level input materialization point: the untrusted archive member header 'ar_size' field is taken (as a bare pointer) from the mmap'd archive header. ar_size is a fixed 10-byte field, right-padded with spaces and NOT NUL-terminated. This pointer is the untrusted value that is subsequently handed to atol().
source.value_from: The fuzzer-supplied Unix `ar` archive file (mmap'd into elf->map_address). `hdr` is the member header at elf->map_address + offset (materialized at libelf/elf_begin.c:743); hdr->ar_size is its 10-byte space-padded decimal size field, controlled byte-for-byte by the input archive.

sink.description: atol() is invoked on the non-NUL-terminated ar_size field. When the field holds no digit (all spaces) and lies at the end of the mapped archive, atol skips the leading whitespace and keeps scanning bytes past the end of the mmap'd region — an out-of-bounds (wild pointer) READ. ASan reports this inside the __interceptor_atol frame (READ of size 985 at 0x7ffffe72f000, a wild pointer).

root_cause.code: len = atol (string);  /* no check that string[0] is a digit */
root_cause.description: read_long_names guarantees NUL-termination of ar_size only when its last byte is not a space (it copies into a stack `buf`); when the field IS space-padded (last byte == ' ') `string` keeps pointing at the raw, non-NUL-terminated mmap'd field. Nothing then validates that the field begins with a digit before calling atol(). For an all-spaces / no-digit ar_size, atol skips the whitespace and reads past the buffer end. The fix adds `if (!isdigit(string[0])) return NULL;` immediately before `len = atol(string);` so atol is only called when there is at least one leading digit (and the value cannot be negative).

tainted_value_origin.description: The archive member header struct is aliased directly onto the mmap'd input bytes at elf->map_address + offset. Its ar_size field (hdr->ar_size) is the tainted decimal-string value that flows into atol().
tainted_value_origin.value_from: Untrusted bytes of the mmap'd `ar` archive supplied by the fuzz-libdwfl testcase.

parser_admitted.condition: The input was accepted as a Unix `ar` archive (ELF_K_AR) and, while iterating member headers, a member name whose second byte is a digit (a long-name reference, isdigit(ar_hdr->ar_name[1])) was encountered, so __libelf_next_arhdr_wrlock dispatches into read_long_names to parse the `//` long-name table. Confirms the bytes passed archive magic/header dispatch and entered the vulnerable long-name parsing path; earlier than the root cause/sink at elf_begin.c:766, later than raw program entry.

coarse_trace.summary: Fuzzer writes the testcase to a temp file and calls dwfl_report_offline on it.
libdwfl offline entry point for reporting an object/archive file.
Opens the file and dispatches on ELF kind.
ELF_K_AR detected; routes to archive processing.
Calls elf_begin(ELF_C_READ_MMAP_PRIVATE) to open the first archive member.
elf_begin -> lock_dup_elf (1119) -> dup_elf reads the next archive member header.
Member name references the long-name table; calls read_long_names to parse it.
atol() over the non-NUL-terminated ar_size field scans past the end of the mmap'd archive -> OOB read.

fine_trace.note: A member header whose name references the long-name table (isdigit(ar_hdr->ar_name[1])) is encountered, so read_long_names is invoked to locate/parse the `//` long-name table entry. This is the parser-admission point into the vulnerable routine.
The archive member header is aliased directly onto the mmap'd input at elf->map_address + offset; its fields (including ar_size) are attacker-controlled bytes.
The untrusted 10-byte, space-padded, non-NUL-terminated ar_size decimal-string field is taken (as a bare pointer) from the mapped header. This is the input value that flows into atol().

Termination is only ensured on the FALSE-of-this-guard path: when the last byte is not a space the field is copied into a NUL-terminated stack buf. When the field is fully space-padded (last byte == ' '), this branch is NOT taken and `string` keeps pointing at the raw, non-NUL-terminated mmap'd bytes.

fine_trace.code: len = atol (string);  /* missing: if (!isdigit(string[0])) return NULL; */
fine_trace.note: Root cause: no check that the ar_size field begins with a digit before calling atol(). The fix inserts `if (!isdigit(string[0])) return NULL;` immediately before this line. Marked 'missing' control edge.

atol skips the leading whitespace of the all-spaces ar_size field and, finding no digit and no NUL, keeps scanning bytes past the end of the mmap'd archive region -> out-of-bounds/wild-pointer READ (ASan unknown-crash, READ of size 985).

sanitizer_ground_truth.region: 0x7ffffe72f000 is a wild pointer inside of access range of size 0x0000000003d9
sanitizer_ground_truth.summary: AddressSanitizer: unknown-crash (out-of-bounds READ of size 985) in __interceptor_atol, called from read_long_names at libelf/elf_begin.c:766

cross_validation.note: sink (elf_begin.c:766 atol) matches the ASan crash frame #1; fine_trace call chain matches the crash stack; the mmap'd ar_size field reaches atol. Reproduced deterministically against n132/arvo:45636-vul; Valgrind not run (prebuilt ASan image).

format.name: Unix ar archive (with GNU/SysV extended long-name member table)
format.contract: The input must be admitted as a Unix `ar` archive (starts with the ARMAG '!<arch>\n' magic so libdwfl classifies it ELF_K_AR and calls elf_begin). It must contain at least one member whose header name references the long-name table (member name second byte is an ASCII digit, isdigit(ar_name[1])) so __libelf_next_arhdr_wrlock invokes read_long_names. To be reachability-comparable, some member header traversed by read_long_names while scanning for the '//' long-name table must have an ar_size field that (a) is fully space-padded (its 16th/last byte is a space, so no NUL-terminated copy is made) and (b) contains no leading decimal digit (e.g. all spaces), and that header must lie at the end of the mmap'd archive so that atol() scans past the mapping boundary. Original PoC bytes are not part of this contract.
